Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method of the Example class, which demonstrates the bug. The bug is triggered because the equals method is overridden without overriding the hashCode method, leading to a violation of the contract that equal objects must have equal hash codes. This results in two equal Example instances having different hash codes, causing the JUnit assertion to fail.
